channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Apple Bets on Foldable iPhone Under New CEO
item.description: Apple CEO John Ternus is preparing for his first major product event since succeeding Tim Cook, with a foldable iPhone expected to headline the September 9 launch. Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Hardware Analyst Woo Jin Ho joins Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason on Bloomberg This Weekend and says Ternus’ engineering background could bring renewed focus to hardware and expanding Apple’s ecosystem as smartphone upgrades become increasingly incremental. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: TCS Plans One-Gigawatt Capacity Data Center in Southern India
item.description: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd. on Saturday said its HyperVault unit and partners have committed 700 billion rupees ($7.4 billion) to set up a large-scale artificial intelligence data center campus in southern India, speeding up its push into an area that Indian tech firms are prioritizing for future growth.
item.dc:creator: Ashutosh Joshi

item.title: Nvidia Partner Hon Hai’s Sales Climb 52% With AI Server Momentum
item.description: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co. reported a 52% rise in monthly sales, lifted by demand for servers in a global race to build data centers and AI computational capacity.
item.dc:creator: Debby Wu

item.title: Jump Trading Expands Office Space in Hong Kong’s IFC Building
item.description: Jump Trading is adding office space in Hong Kong, according to people familiar with the matter, the latest sign of global trading firms expanding their presence in the city.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg News

item.title: Japan Says Progress Made on $550 Billion Investment Pact With US
item.description: Japanese Trade Minister Ryosei Akazawa said progress was being made on a $550 billion investment initiative set up as part of a trade deal with the US last year.
item.dc:creator: Yoshiaki Nohara

item.title: China’s 26% Earnings Boom Lands With a Thud in the Stock Market
item.description: China’s best profit growth in five years hasn’t been enough to reignite a stock rally, with a weak economy and doubts over AI returns sapping investor enthusiasm.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg News

item.title: Ayako Yoshioka Discusses Tech’s Impact on Inflation and Prices
item.description: Ayako Yoshioka, a Senior Investment Strategist at Wealth Enhancement Group, joins the show to discuss technology’s role in the inflation outlook. The segment frames a client conversation around whether technology could help stoke inflation in the near term or, alternatively, contribute to lower prices and cost relief for the broader economy over time. She speaks with Scarlet Fu & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Strong Jobs Report Revives Fed Rate-Hike Bets
item.description: The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Kayne Anderson Rudnick Portfolio Manager, Senior Research Analyst Julie Biel, KPMG Chief Economist Diane Swonk, Jefferies Tech Sector Leader, Software/Internet Research Brent Thill, Zscaler CEO Jay Chaudhury, Wealth Enhancement Group Senior Investment Strategist Ayako Yoshioka, The Points Guy Senior Newsletter Editor Becky Blaine, & SUNY Purchase President Michael Steiper. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Diane Swonk Says August Jobs Report Shows Mixed but Strong Labor Market Signals
item.description: Diane Swonk, Chief Economist at KPMG, discusses the August jobs report, which showed U.S. payrolls rising by 162,000, above expectations, while the unemployment rate held steady at 4.1%. The segment also notes revisions to prior figures and points out that the data contain a lot of noise. She speaks with Scarlet Fu & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Jay Chaudhry Says AI Is Driving More Demand for Cybersecurity at Zscaler
item.description: Zscaler CEO Jay Chaudhry said AI is creating a major tailwind for the cybersecurity industry rather than reducing the need for software security. He argued that CEOs, CIOs, and boards want to use AI for productivity and cost savings, but are worried that new AI models could create vulnerabilities, lead to breaches, or cause applications to be hacked or hijacked. He speaks with Scarlet Fu & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: What Adam Smith Would Say of Bond Market Turmoil (Video)
What Is AGI? OpenAI, Anthropic Race for Artificial General Intelligence
item.description: AI companies are in a race to create artificial general intelligence, seeing it as the catalyst for an “intelligence explosion” that reshapes the economy and society. If only they could agree on what AGI would actually look like, and how it might be achieved
item.dc:creator: Agnee Ghosh and Seth Fiegerman

item.title: Apple: Ternus trae récord de lanzamientos tras salida de Tim Cook
item.description: Desde el iPhone plegable hasta una MacBook con pantalla táctil, esto es lo que podemos esperar el 9 de septiembre y en adelante.
item.dc:creator: Mark Gurman

item.title: Apple Kicks Off Ternus Era With Record Product Pipeline
item.description: Apple is kicking off its John Ternus era with what could be the biggest run of new device releases in its history. Next week's product launch is expected to introduce foldables, new iPhones, and an updated Apple Watch. Bloomberg's Sam Kelly joins Bloomberg’s Lisa Mateo on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Anthropic Builds Its War Chest Ahead of IPO | Bloomberg Tech 9/04/2026
item.description: Bloomberg’s Lisa Mateo takes a look at Anthropic as it finalizes an expansion of its revolving credit facility to $15 billion before its anticipated public filing. Plus, a look at the latest US jobs report showing the IT sector shed 23,000 jobs in August; and Apple is kicking off the John Ternus era with what could be the biggest run of new devices in its history. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: OpenAI Rolls Out Its Most Advanced Model Yet
item.description: OpenAI is rolling out its most advanced model yet, with GPT-6 Astra being positioned as a major step toward AGI - but its powerful cybersecurity capabilities are also forcing OpenAI to put new guardrails in place. Bloomberg's Seth Fiegerman joins Bloomberg’s Lisa Mateo on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AI Cloud Firm Nscale Seeks $3.5 Billion in Pre-IPO Financing
item.description: Nscale, a cloud computing firm focused on artificial intelligence, is in talks with potential investors to raise as much as $3.5 billion in financing ahead of a planned initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reshmi Basu and Bailey Lipschultz

item.title: Carney’s Push to Build Canadian Data Centers is Running Into Backlash
item.description: The data center backlash that has gripped US politics is spreading north, complicating Prime Minister Mark Carney’s efforts to attract investment in the rapidly expanding artificial intelligence infrastructure.
item.dc:creator: Nojoud Al Mallees

item.title: Abu Dhabi’s G42 Weighs US Ownership to Safeguard AI Chip Access
item.description: Executives at Abu Dhabi-based artificial intelligence firm G42 have held exploratory talks over potentially selling a majority stake to American companies, people familiar with the matter said, as it races to guarantee access to high-tech chips beyond next year.
item.dc:creator: Alex Dooler, Zainab Fattah and Dinesh Nair

item.title: Meet the Biggest Ad Buyer in the Podcasting Industry
item.description: BetterHelp is the top podcast advertiser of all time. Since 2023, the talk therapy provider has spent $242 million on ads in the space, according to one firm’s estimates
item.dc:creator: Ashley Carman
